description: In a nonempty directed preorder the upper tails form a base for the top filter; on the naturals this gives the tail base for the cofinite filter.
signature:
Filter.atTop_basis.{u_3} {α : Type u_3} [Preorder α] [IsDirectedOrder α] [Nonempty α] :
  Filter.atTop.HasBasis (fun x => True) Set.Ici
